proof.text: A partial closed datum [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] consists of the family of transposition equivalences together with the naturality condition, which is a property. Equal families (function extensionality in $L$ and the pair) therefore give equal data.

title: Partial closed data are determined by their transpositions
statement: Let $C$ be a preadditive category, $T:C\times C\to C$ a tensor bifunctor, $J$ an object predicate on $C^{op}\times C$ and $H:J\to C$. Two partial closed data $S,S'$ for $(T,J,H)$ [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] whose additive transposition equivalences $\operatorname{Hom}(T(L,M),N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(L,H(M,N))$ coincide for every object $L$ and every permitted pair $(M,N)$ are equal.

lean.statement:
theorem podPartialClosed_ext
    {C : Type a} [Category.{b} C] [Preadditive C]
    {T : C × C ⥤ C} {J : ObjectProperty (Cᵒᵖ × C)} {H : J.FullSubcategory ⥤ C}
    (S S' : PodPartialClosed T J H)
    (h : ∀ L P, S.transpose L P = S'.transpose L P) : S = S'
